contradictions.what: Rep says the customer was 'building a portal' but later says Paul's team isn't building anything and the portal is off the shelf.
Rep says she only understood the CFO angle around the third call, yet Ines wasn't on the first call and the reconciliation reaction came after.
Rep says Ines 'sat on' the proposal, but then explains it went to Paul, who forwarded it; Ines only read the first page after delay.
Rep says 'Not much' changed in questions after the bank talk, then describes a new ask: a named contact.
Rep had the deal at 20% and 'dead' before the data meeting, though Ines had already said 'go back' and asked to see it with her data.
Rep cites only finding the CFO sooner as a regret, but also left a reference gap Ines raised twice and never closed.

dodges.question: What did the customer bring up about the competitor?
dodges.what: Rep said she doesn't know what Fiserv showed and 'that's about all I've got'; little on competitive evaluation.

dodges.question: What changed in their questions after they'd talked to the bank?
dodges.what: Answered 'Not much' then described a new question about a named contact.

dodges.question: Anything you'd do differently?
dodges.what: Gave one short answer; did not mention the reference gap or the untested branch card-reader demo.
